name: Candle and Ink (Chúc Mặc Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Seven Stars in One Stroke (Nhất Bút Thất Tinh)
bonuses.rule: every seventh talisman you throw at one foe closes the Dipper: it deals 0.85 Chaos damage for each of your Wood stacks on that foe and spends them all, and your talisman marks and curses on that foe cannot be cleansed for 8 s.

story: The founder's candle and the ink gourd Kỷ Ngân Chúc made when she took the hall in 1137. The candle stays in the hall; she carries it out only to fight, and the hall does not like it. She wears them beside the Talisman-Bearer's Ring.
